title: Provincial Employees Social Security Amendment Act 2019

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Employees Social Security Amendment Act 2019
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXIV OF 2019
ACT XXIV OF 2019
PROVINCIAL EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2019
An Act further to amend the Provincial Employees'
Social Security Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
13th December, 2019]
No.
PAP/Legis-2(14)12019/2165, dated 13.12.2019.---The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Bill 2019,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on November 20,
2019, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on December 10, 2019, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It
is necessary further to amend the Provincial Employees' Social Security
Ordinance, 1965 (X of 1965) to broaden the definition of an employee.
Be
it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Act,
2019.
(2) It
shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and
from 13th October, 2019.

Amendment in section 2 of Ordinance X of 1965

ACT XXIV OF 2019
ACT XXIV OF 2019

ACT, 2019
An Act further to amend the Provincial Employees'

[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
13th December, 2019]
No.
PAP/Legis-2(14)12019/2165, dated 13.12.2019.---The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Bill 2019,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on November 20,
2019, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on December 10, 2019, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It
is necessary further to amend the Provincial Employees' Social Security
Ordinance, 1965 (X of 1965) to broaden the definition of an employee.
Be
it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
2. Amendment
in section 2 of Ordinance X of 1965.---In the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 (X of
1965), in section 2, in clause (8). for the existing sub-clause (f), the
following shall be substituted and shall be deemed to have always been so
substituted:
"(f)
any person employed on wages exceeding the wages determined by the Government
under section 71:
Provided
that an employee shall not cease to be an employee for the sole reason that his
monthly wages exceed the wages determined by the Government under section 71 of
the Ordinance;".
